comments.author: Alrn
comments.body:
The official name is "Ancient Civilization Decor 1". You can get this by digging the yellow pillar spot in "Great Pyramid of Giza" legacy site (not the regular Giza inland).

This is deco ship and can be installed on Back Right or Back Left.

Also i can't seem to find an ivyro page for "Hawk Deco Sculpture" deco ship so i just put here for a while. You can also obtain by the same method as above. You can install it as Flag.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Update 3.3 "Babylon" will allow this item to be transmuted into Ishtar Gate -- details on its page.

wiki: Randomly awarded from the light pillars located inside the Legacy Zone, Great Pyramid of Giza -- Search skill R10 or greater required to obtain.
